clue.text: A lass, dull one, keeping company with awkward lad

parts.note: matt (also spelt mat) describes a dull, unshiny finish
the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: awkward suggests the letters of lad are clumsily rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl, rather boring herself, is seen out with an ungainly young man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping company with' simply joins the pieces; 'awkward' rearranges LAD into LDA.
explanation.definitionFit: Matilda is a girl's given name, so it can stand for a lass.

clue.text: Work of art presented by the head of state?

definitions.text: Work of art presented by the head of state?

parts.words: Work of art presented by the head of state?
parts.note: the head of state sounds like a president, but read literally it is a cape (a headland) belonging to a land, and a painting of scenery

explanation.surface: A painting given as a gift by a country's president.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting of countryside scenery is a kind of artwork, and split into three words it is a headland of a country.

clue.text: Accountant going into lounge to add up some figures again

indicators.note: going into tells us the accountant is placed inside the word for lounge

parts.note: to lounge is to rest or relax idly
CA stands for chartered accountant

explanation.surface: An accountant slumps on a sofa to redo some sums.
explanation.definitionFit: To recast a column of figures is to total them a second time.

clue.text: Go on once unit is reorganised

indicators.note: being reorganised means the letters of once and unit are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Carry on as before, now that the department has been restructured.
explanation.definitionFit: To go on is to carry on or proceed without stopping.

clue.text: They go around in a flashy kind of way

definitions.text: They go around in a flashy kind of way

parts.words: They go around in a flashy kind of way
parts.note: seemingly showy people about town, but really spinning fireworks that whirl round throwing off sparks

explanation.surface: Show-offs who parade about town in flamboyant style.
explanation.definitionFit: These spinning fireworks are pinned to a post and rotate while shooting out sparks, a literally flashy rotation.

clue.text: A top man negotiating open loan

indicators.note: negotiating suggests working the letters of open and loan round into a new form

explanation.surface: A senior figure brokers a deal on an unrestricted loan.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon Bonaparte rose to be emperor of France, the very top man of his day.

clue.text: Sleep in it, though it's not really suitable

indicators.note: in places the word for sleep inside the word it

parts.note: taken as written
a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: Dozing in a particular spot, though the spot is rather inappropriate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'though it's' is only a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inapt is inappropriate or ill-suited to its purpose.

clue.text: Family member assuming a right that's questionable

parts.note: an uncle is a relative, a member of the family

explanation.surface: A relative presumes he has some entitlement, which is doubtful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assuming' and 'that's' are link words here: the pieces simply follow one another.
explanation.definitionFit: Something questionable is doubtful, not clear-cut or certain.

clue.text: Set around a stately home

indicators.note: around tells us the word for set wraps itself about the letter a

parts.note: to set something down is to place it

explanation.surface: A film set built round a grand country house.
explanation.definitionFit: A palace is a grand official residence, the most magnificent kind of stately home.

clue.text: Take sound steps to provide entertainment

definitions.text: Take sound steps to provide entertainment

parts.words: Take sound steps to provide entertainment
parts.note: sound steps look like sensible measures, but they are footsteps that make a noise, performed on stage with metal-tipped shoes

explanation.surface: Act sensibly in order to put on a show.
explanation.definitionFit: This dance uses shoes with metal plates so every step clicks audibly for an audience.

clue.text: Where a winger will come clean

definitions.text: Where a winger will come clean

parts.words: Where a winger will come clean
parts.note: a winger looks like a footballer and coming clean like confessing, but it is a bird having a wash

explanation.surface: The place where a wide footballer finally owns up.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden basin of water where birds splash about to wash themselves.

clue.text: Refuse a stretcher

definitions.meaning: refuse as a noun means rubbish strewn about
a stretcher here is a portable bed for carrying the sick or wounded

explanation.surface: Turn down a hospital carrying frame.
explanation.definitionFit: Scattered rubbish is called this, and so is a couch carried on poles for moving a patient.

clue.text: A teacher turning churlish about a philosopher

indicators.note: about tells us the turned word goes round the philosopher
turning tells us the word for churlish is read backwards

parts.note: churlish means rude or ill-mannered
Cato the Younger was a Roman statesman and Stoic philosopher

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster turns surly towards a thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes RUDE into EDUR, and 'about' wraps that round CATO: EDU-CATO-R.
explanation.definitionFit: An educator is someone who instructs others, a schoolmaster or tutor.

clue.text: Hero-worship adroitly manipulated

indicators.note: manipulated means the letters of adroitly are handled and shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: Fan adulation cleverly stage-managed by a publicist.
explanation.definitionFit: Idolatry is the worship of idols, so figuratively excessive adoration of a hero.

clue.text: The citadel's made a cut - -oil's problematic

parts.note: to crop is to cut short

indicators.note: problematic suggests the letters of oil's are in a troubled, jumbled state

parts.note: the possessive s is taken as a letter here, giving the four letters o, i, l, s

explanation.surface: Building the fortress meant a reduction, as the oil supply was a headache.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' is a link. 'problematic' rearranges OILS into OLIS, completing A + CROP + OLIS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Acropolis of Athens is the most famous hilltop citadel of ancient Greece.

clue.text: No front entrance should make one cross!

definitions.text: No front entrance should make one cross!

parts.words: No front entrance should make one cross!
parts.note: cross looks like angry, but it means to go over a threshold, here one at the rear of a house

explanation.surface: Having no proper front door ought to annoy anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: A rear entrance to a building, the way in that is not at the front.

clue.text: A feeling of exasperation followed by depression, all due to a dog

parts.note: ire is anger or exasperation
a dale is a valley, a depression in the land

explanation.surface: Irritation and then gloom, all caused by a pet hound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'followed by' and 'all due to a' only link the pieces to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Airedale is a large terrier breed from Yorkshire, England.

clue.text: Set apart, and this is nothing new

parts.note: taken as written
O resembles zero, nothing
late can mean recent, as in the latest news

explanation.surface: Keep it separate: this report is not news at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and this' is a link; 'new' gives LATE in the sense of recent, as in the late news.
explanation.definitionFit: To isolate something is to separate it or keep it apart from others.

clue.text: Quite unusual rose-red screen

indicators.note: something quite unusual is out of the ordinary, so the letters of rose-red are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remarkable screen in an unusual pinkish-red colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A reredos is an ornamental screen or panel behind a church altar.

clue.text: Ramble on? Sure thing!

definitions.meaning: read as two words, to stroll across ground
a sure thing is a certain win, an easy victory

explanation.surface: Keep wandering? Certainly!
explanation.definitionFit: Split in two it means to stroll across; as one word it is an easy, uncontested victory.

clue.text: Beaten for having given tongue

definitions.meaning: to have given something a lick with the tongue

explanation.surface: Defeated after speaking out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given tongue' usually means spoke up or barked; here it means applied the tongue. 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Licked is slang for thrashed or defeated, and literally means touched with the tongue.

clue.text: American Indian medicine man associated with a certain bird

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
a hawk is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A tribal healer linked to a particular bird totem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'medicine man' suggests a shaman, fitting the surface, but it is MO, the Medical Officer. 'associated with' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mohawk are a Native American people of the Iroquois confederacy.

clue.text: Young woman found to be at fault

definitions.meaning: a young woman is a miss; with the article that is two words
at fault means wrong or awry

explanation.surface: A girl is discovered to be to blame.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, A MISS is a young woman; as one word it means wrong. 'found to be' links the two.
explanation.definitionFit: As one word it means wrong or out of order; split, it is a single unmarried girl.

clue.text: Mean in the extreme when hemmed in

indicators.note: in places the word for mean inside the word for the extreme

parts.note: an end is an extreme point
close means stingy or mean with money

explanation.surface: Stingy to the utmost when trapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' is a link. CLOSE goes inside END: EN-CLOSE-D.
explanation.definitionFit: Something enclosed is surrounded and shut in on all sides.

clue.text: Obstruct it and a person will give voice

parts.note: to bar is to block or obstruct
taken as written
one can mean a person, as in one does one's best

explanation.surface: Block it and someone will protest out loud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' and 'will give' are links; 'give voice' looks like speak out, but 'voice' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male singing voice between tenor and bass.

clue.text: A leader-writer gets some credit ordinarily

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A newspaper columnist usually earns some praise.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'gets', which is a link word joining definition to wordplay; the definition is 'A leader-writer'.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaders are newspaper editorials, written by the editor or a senior journalist.

clue.text: Disapproves of curs seen running wild

indicators.note: running wild means the letters of curs and seen career off into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone objects to mongrels spotted roaming loose.
explanation.definitionFit: To censure is to criticise or condemn formally, to express disapproval.
